preconditions.description: Contract must be activated (trading open, fees enabled, swap enabled, token hold enabled, auto claim enabled, reward as tokens enabled)
Attacker must hold at least minRewardBalance (50000 * 10^9 tokens) to be included in rewards
Contract must have BNB balance for rewards (mainBnbPoolSize is 5000 ether)

exploit_hint: Call setClaimRewardAsTokensPercentage(100) as attacker to set your reward claim percentage to 100%. This will cause all your BNB rewards to be converted to LLG tokens instead of receiving BNB. Since the function has no access control, anyone can call it. After setting to 100%, claim rewards to receive LLG tokens instead of BNB. This bypasses the intended restriction that only the contract owner should be able to configure this setting.
